text:
mike: Planning a 45m workshop tomorrow to finalize the long-term routing + multi-tenant isolation roadmap. Focus: concrete spec items, launch criteria, and prioritized customer asks (Acme / FinApps / Healthcare). Bring one slide and deps.
maya: +1. Make sure Dedicated/Private rollout constraints are on the agenda. Data residency and deterministic latency keep coming up.
vikram: Proposed spec addition: model-aware routing matrix (kernel/quant compat), explicit fallback ordering, and a per-tenant KV cache migration cost calc.
nana: Observability acceptance criteria: token-level traces, per-route p95, model-variant cost attribution, and trace-id propagation through router->runtime->console.
sara: Draft launch gates: cross-region fallback adds <200ms p95 under normal load; canary for 1% tenant-slice with auto-fallback; console surfaces token cost by model/route; documented migration + rollback playbook.
kim: Prioritization sketch: (1) isolation lanes for regulated customers, (2) low-latency affinity lanes, (3) cost-optimized shared lanes. Map these lanes to Dedicated/Private availability windows.
mike: Action: everyone drop 3 bullets here (customer ask, hard dependency, acceptance gate). I'll synth into a strawman spec for the workshop.
maya: Acme ask: pinned model variants per region + 99.9 latency SLA. Dependency: Dedicated pools + KMS. Gate: per-region SLA test harness and runbook.
vikram: FinApps ask: predictable token economics for reranking-heavy workloads. Dependency: batching, quant profiles, optimizer passes. Gate: perf regression <5% vs baseline and documentation on quant tradeoffs.
nana: Healthcare ask: VPC/on-prem option and audit logs. Dependency: Private control plane + HSM integration. Gate: SOC-like audit trail and e2e deploy runbook.
sara: Ops gates: tenant eviction/runaway protection playbook, SLO docs, synthetic prompt set for quality regression checks, and auto-rollback triggers tied to eval signals.
vikram: Canary policy sketch (example):
```
policy:
  fallback_order: [regional-variant, quantized-variant, cpu-fallback]
  canary:
    type: tenant-slice
    percent: 1
    duration_hours: 72
    rollback_signal: quality_regression > 0.5%
```
nana: Telemetry requirement: expose route_id, model_variant, token_count, token_cost, trace_id on each span and surface in console with links to raw traces.
sara: Ops note: need an automated rollback path for quantized models if eval-set quality drops; include escalation matrix and contact list in runbook.
mike: Workshop agenda: 1) customer asks + deps (15m), 2) draft spec & canary patterns (15m), 3) acceptance gates & telemetry (10m), 4) timeline & owners (5m). Bring slides. :thumbsup:
